title: Provisional measurement review
notice: These are newly derived, unvalidated educational observations. The source supplies no printed answer key for this exercise. They are unscored and require qualified ECG educator review.

fields.basis: Visually checked ventricular landmarks on original PDF 515
fields.reason: Successive ventricular peak spacings: 62 px, 60 px, 62 px, 60 px, 60 px, 59 px, 60 px, 60 px, 62 px, 60 px, 63 px. Descriptive judgment from visible spacing, not a validated diagnostic threshold.

fields.basis: Course-standard 25 mm/s assumption; 150 independently detected small-square intervals across 738 pixels
fields.reason: Mean R–R estimate 121.5 bpm; six-second count estimate 120 bpm. All seconds/bpm depend on course-standard 25 mm/s. Count estimate assumes 150 small squares = 6 seconds; endpoint phase and partial complexes affect it. On irregular strips the count estimate is not a stable instantaneous rate. Mean RR describes only intervals between observed peaks.

fields.value: Candidate P-wave observation: Between-complex contours are broad and often double-humped. No discrete, repeatable P onset can be separated confidently from the preceding recovery/terminal wave. P presence or absence is unresolved. A repeated hump pattern exists, but which portion is atrial, terminal ventricular recovery or overlap is not established. A one-to-one P-to-QRS claim would overstate the image.
fields.basis: Original PDF page 515; independently reconciled selected-complex observation
fields.reason: Provisional deflection description, not validated atrial identity or a diagnosis. Describes visible morphology/association only, not established P identity, atrial origin or conduction. For the complexes near x104, 166 and 228, is the descent from the preceding plateau part of QRS or the preceding terminal/P-T contour? Is the end of the rapid post-S recovery the J point, or does QRS extend into the subsequent shoulder? An educator must identify both boundaries before a QRS field is released. This describes only the selected complexes or restricted subset. It does not establish a whole-strip event census, ventricular sequence completeness, atrial identity, or conduction relationship. Qualified ECG educator review is outstanding.

fields.value: Fast, closely spaced complexes with changing surrounding waveform appearance. No atrial origin or conduction diagnosis assigned.

limitations: Wave observations and conditional endpoint envelopes remain provisional and unscored. QT/QTc, calibrated amplitudes and clinical diagnosis are not established. Selected-complex widths do not establish sequence certainty.
pr unresolved: Withheld as PR: no defensible discrete P onset is selected. The failure is wave identity/overlap, not missing grid calibration.

qrs unresolved: Competing initial-downstroke versus rapid-upstroke definitions, and early versus later terminal recovery definitions, produce a broad exploratory QRS envelope. Do not turn this into an exact duration or narrow/wide key.

P-wave text is a provisional description, not validated atrial identity. PR remains unresolved with no numerical answer. QRS remains unresolved with no numerical answer. Validated electrical boundaries and qualified educator adjudication remain outstanding.
Calibration assumes the course’s 25 mm/s convention, not speed metadata printed on each strip. Peak uncertainty is approximately ±2 source pixels, excluding errors in identifying the waveform.
